description: Audit a property against the FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer (NFHL) to detect Special Flood Hazard Areas (Zone A/AE/VE), FIRM panels, base flood elevation, mandatory flood insurance encumbrances, and calculate Board-admissible external obsolescence appraisal deductions (Exhibit F).

format.description: Output format: 'json' (default) or 'html' for ready-to-file Exhibit F

name: audit_fema_flood_hazard
